newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber ends lower on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber ends lower on long liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Thursday on active long-liquidation, traders said.
A spreading view that nearby months would be pressured by an oversupply, dampened market sentiment, the traders said.
Prices ranged from 3.2 yen to 5.2 yen per kg lower. Benchmark December closed 3.2 yen weaker at 121.3 yen.
"Sentiment is overwhelmingly bearish after the spot June contract fell below 110 yen from the outset. Prices are expected to slip further," one trader said.
